basis: Andrew, 28 Oct 2026, late evening: "Things in build are no longer showing 100% please fix." The Build progress bar read 6 of 7 areas at 100%: VMS boards had 7 references with 4 Complete at the Fri 23 Oct cut-off, though all 24 boards were on site. The three Premiair references VMS-01 (VMS21), VMS-02 (VMS22) and VMS-03 (VMS24) were added to the record on 27 Oct and their Complete ticks carry that day's time, after the cut-off; the boards themselves were in place on 22 Oct 2026, as the record's own on-site stamps and Andrew's 27 Oct word ("22 oct", Premiair docket 26143911) already say. Each Complete is dated to its reference's on-site stamp. Receipt and install are dated to the same on-site stamp, since each board was delivered and put in place on arrival.
